description: My name is Olerato Gogontle Moseja I'm an 18 year old motswana girl child. I graduated in my high school degree with 44 points. I have participated in the mathematics Olympiad. I am a part of the mission ShakthiSAT initiative and competed with 108 girls in the country to go to India and build two satellites. I have experienced coding and pythons before. I have participated in the Geo Indeginous Ltkome summit as well as the Yohaku Space Debris Hackathon and became a double award winner.
